{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [15:0] bit_gt;
    wire [15:0] bit_lt;
    wire [3:0] group_gt;
    wire [3:0] group_lt;
    wire [3:0] group_eq;

    assign bit_gt = A & ~B;
    assign bit_lt = ~A & B;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : groups
            wire [3:0] g;
            wire [3:0] l;
            wire [3:0] pg;
            wire [3:0] pl;
            assign g = bit_gt[4*k +: 4];
            assign l = bit_lt[4*k +: 4];
            assign pg = ~l;
            assign pl = ~g;

            assign group_gt[k] = g[3]
                               | (pg[3] & g[2])
                               | (pg[3] & pg[2] & g[1])
                               | (pg[3] & pg[2] & pg[1] & g[0]);
            assign group_lt[k] = l[3]
                               | (pl[3] & l[2])
                               | (pl[3] & pl[2] & l[1])
                               | (pl[3] & pl[2] & pl[1] & l[0]);
            assign group_eq[k] = ~(group_gt[k] | group_lt[k]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign gt = group_gt[3]
              | (group_eq[3] & group_gt[2])
              | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_gt[1])
              | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_gt[0]);
    assign lt = group_lt[3]
              | (group_eq[3] & group_lt[2])
              | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_lt[1])
              | (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_lt[0]);
    assign eq = &group_eq;
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline's worst reported path reaches gt in 0.88 ns through several comparison-combining stages. Equality also reaches a relatively slow, shared NOR stage at 0.80 ns.",
  "rewrite": "Use four parallel four-bit comparison blocks followed by an explicit four-way priority lookahead. Within each block, greater-than propagates through bits that are not less-than, and less-than propagates through bits that are not greater-than. These permissive propagates are exact because a higher-priority winning bit already determines that comparison. Block equality is derived from the two mutually exclusive block comparison results.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The bounded four-bit local logic and parallel block lookahead target a reduction from the 0.88 ns baseline. Actual improvement requires mapping and STA; no numerical timing gain or electrical-violation result is claimed without those runs.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shares bitwise greater/less predicates and avoids a separate bank of bitwise equality comparators. Explicit lookahead adds product terms and some fanout. Mapped area must be checked against 547.775360 um2, together with the required zero max-slew and max-capacitance violations.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, unsigned 16-bit input ports, and scalar output ports. For every binary assignment of all 32 input bits, gt is exactly A > B, lt is exactly A < B, and eq is exactly A == B. The implementation is purely combinational and introduces no parameters, storage, assumptions, dependencies, or undefined outputs."
}
